scene: Inside the rattling tram, strange crates surround you.
picture: Inside a moving tram car with metal floor panels, a teal crate glows with purple sparks on the left. The young Black woman in her yellow raincoat and green boots stands mid-left holding her red umbrella. A robot conductor stands at centre, stacked packages sit right, and a red lever waits far right.
shown: A large teal crate humming with purple sparks on the left
A friendly robot conductor wearing a blue cap standing at centre
A shiny red lever mounted on the wall at the far right

variants.scene: The open-sided cargo tram rumbles across the bridge into the purple evening.
Dim overhead bulbs sway while you keep looking for {quest}.
Cool harbor air blows past stacks of parcels and a crackling metal container.
